title: Pushed out of walls
description:
Move a box and push it out of walls along the shortest side.

```
player (90, 50, 20, 20) moving right into wall (100, 0, 50, 200)
overlap x 10, y 20 -> push left by 10, stop moving right
sliding along the wall still works
```
hints: Overlap on x is `std::min(a.x + a.w, b.x + b.w) - std::max(a.x, b.x)`; positive on both axes means they overlap (lesson 3.02).
Moving one axis at a time means you always know which side you hit: the one you were moving towards.
requirements: `overlap(a, b)` returns how far they overlap on each axis (or none).
Resolve on the axis with the smaller overlap, in the direction away from the wall, and zero that speed.
Move x and resolve, then move y and resolve, so corners do not snag.
stretch: Add one-way platforms you can jump through from below.
